patterns.note: A dark, full-width background serves as a canvas for content sections, which are primarily centered and contained, with a distinct hero section and a grid of feature cards.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif for impact, while body text is a legible, slightly smaller sans-serif. Category labels are small and uppercase.
Vibrant, distinct linear gradients are used as backgrounds for feature cards, providing strong visual separation and a modern aesthetic against the dark page background.
The abstract spheres in the hero section exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to links as the user scrolls down the page.

technique_notes: The hero background elements are animated to move at a slower rate than the page scroll, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. The main navigation is implemented as a fixed element that stays at the top of the screen.

Feature cards are designed with full-bleed linear gradient backgrounds that transition between two distinct, vibrant colors, providing a strong visual identity for each service against a dark page backdrop.
A consistent dark background color is used across the entire page, allowing white text and colorful graphic elements to pop and maintain high contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder (~3-4x body) for strong hierarchy, while body text is standard and labels are small uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to cards and buttons, providing a soft, modern edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with an airy hero section and a more compact, yet well-padded, feature card grid.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold use of distinct, vibrant gradient backgrounds for each feature card, which pop dramatically against the deep, minimal dark background. This creates a strong visual identity for each service while maintaining a cohesive, modern aesthetic.
